samples.xml_description:
<module id="JC_counter">
    <description>Implement a 64-bit Johnson counter.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset input.</input>
        <output id="Q" width_description="[63:0]">64-bit counter output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="Q_right_increament_shifting">The right increament shifting operation of Q.</parameter>
        <parameter id="Q_right_decreament_shifting">The right decreament shifting operation of Q.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequencial_logic">
        <line>sequencial logic operation: JC_counter_Q_update_logic</line>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <line>On every rising edge of the clock signal (clk) or the falling edge of the reset signal (rst_n), the counter value is updated.</line>
        <line>if the reset signal (rst_n) is low, indicating a reset condition, the counter value (Q) is set to 0.</line>
        <line>otherwise, if the least significant bit (Q[0]) is 0, the counter increments by shifting the current value Q based on Q_right_increament_shifting.</line>
        <line>if the least significant bit (Q[0]) is 1, the counter decrements by shifting the current value based on Q_right_decreament_shifting.</line>
    </implementation>
</module>
